designs.note: Main manta ray (1100-1103): all four moth or bat-like wing shapes with no head or cephalic fins. Backup stingray (1150-1153): two inside a circular frame, two with a tail at both ends and no eyes. Slot empty.
1202 the only clear coiled shell; ribbed and unstriped, more ammonite than nautilus, so titled SPIRAL SHELL. Line broke the ribs into blotches, pen kept them. fails [], 25.8 x 34.4 cm.
All four a ginkgo leaf or hand fan on a stalk, no hinge ears. No backup: one generation at a time (two ran out of memory) and the sand dollar could not start before minute 85. Slot empty.

1402 the clearest face: ringed eyes, nostrils, pout, spines whole all round. A little cartoonish, no fins, no species named. Pen over line (line screened the lower body grey). fails [], 26.0 x 27.0 cm.
All four drawn as a land tree with grass, roots and ground. Ready at minute 87, past 85, so no backup. Slot empty.

issues: Running the slot-1 backup in parallel with the main batch got the main run OOM-killed (15 GB, about 10 GB per pipeline) after four images; mains 2-5 were re-queued after the backup, which cost the time for any further backups.
